text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein says he is determined to increase production and revenues and improve services.
- Iraq and the United Nations agree to speed up implementation of oil-for-food deal.
- Mina al-Bakr receives more oil tankers.
- Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz ends Moscow visit and returns to Baghdad.
- Delegation from Chinese communist party arrives in Baghdad.
- (The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA).
